app.name: Code lock
app.summary: A keypad on the screen: the right code unlocks a lock or runs a script, a scene or a button.
app.code_hint: 4 to 8 digits. The screen checks it, so it is stored on the screen: use it for convenience, not as your only lock.
app.pass_code: Pass the code to the lock
app.pass_code_hint: For a lock with a code of its own in Home Assistant: the typed code goes along with the unlock, and Home Assistant checks it. Leave Code empty to let Home Assistant decide alone.
app.attempts_hint: After this many wrong codes in a row the keypad waits before it takes another.
app.wait_hint: How long the keypad waits, in seconds.
